scenario.toml.description: Defines the RF equipment, metrics, and network endpoints. The source is floating and the destination is connected. Both endpoints use the same technology and frequency.

required_section_groups.description: Declare a node CSV in [instances] or provide embedded [[sites]]. When sites are embedded, the node CSV is not read.

scenario.description: Required when coordinates are supplied only as projected x and y.

working_crs.description: Projected CRS for x and y in node and pole inputs.

instances.description: Defines the node CSV when sites are not embedded.

sites.description: Embedded site records. Supply these or declare [instances].

antennas.description: Antenna profiles referenced by the RF interfaces.

interfaces.description: Interface profiles used by device profiles. Each profile defines technology, frequency, transmit power, and antenna reference.

devices.description: Device profiles referenced by node and pole rows. Each profile lists its interfaces.

metrics.description: Metric configuration by technology. The link study requires a metric for the endpoints' technology.

net.description: Connectivity rules and explicit candidate edges for the scenario.

overrides.description: Per-interface enabled overrides keyed by concrete interface ID under [overrides.interfaces].

mesh.description: Mesh link search defaults. Operation arguments take precedence.

mesh.poles.description: Declares a separate repeater pole inventory.

attachments.description: Declares an attached-equipment inventory for bundle validation.

nodes.csv.required_when: The scenario declares instances and has no embedded sites.

device_profile.description: Required profile reference. The column name can be changed with instances.profile_column.

site_id.description: Stable site identifier. Aliases are position_id, id, and name.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees. Use with lon, or use x and y in scenario.working_crs.

connected.description: Whether the device already has network connectivity.

can_route.description: Whether the device can route traffic.

candidate.description: Whether the site is potential infrastructure.

mount_height_m.description: Mounting height in metres. Aliases are ant_h and antenna_height_m.

required_column_groups.description: Provide at least one complete coordinate pair for each row. Projected coordinates use scenario.working_crs.

poles.csv.required_when: The scenario declares a separate pole inventory.

pole_id.description: Required unique pole identifier, distinct from existing site IDs.

device_profile.description: Required device profile reference. The column name can be changed with mesh.poles.profile_column.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees. Use with lon, or use x and y in scenario.working_crs.

required_column_groups.description: Provide at least one complete coordinate pair for each row. Projected coordinates use scenario.working_crs.

attached_equipment.csv.description: Descriptive inventory for installed-network workflows. The RF path search does not consume it.

equipment_id.description: Required identifier, unique within the equipment type.
